Welcome to the studio

A personal practice, built around you

Pilates is suitable for all populations. It supports postural alignment, neuromuscular control, core stability, and joint mobility.

The Pilates method aids in injury rehabilitation, pre/postnatal care, age-related decline, and movement dysfunction. Programs can be adapted to meet individual needs and functional goals.

A fully-equipped studio offers a one-of-a-kind experience in a comfortable, personal and professional atmosphere. Browse our site to learn more.

The Pilates Experience

Movement with purpose

Every session is adapted to your body, your goals and your stage of life — from your first class to advanced practice.

01

Postural alignment

Rebalance the body and move the way you were designed to — tall, centred and at ease.

02

Core stability

Build deep, functional strength that supports your spine and everything you do.

03

Neuromuscular control

Retrain movement patterns so strength, balance and coordination work together.

04

Joint mobility

Keep joints moving freely and comfortably, at every age and fitness level.

05

Injury rehabilitation

Gentle, tailored movement to support recovery and help you manage chronic pain.

06

Pre & postnatal care

Safe, supportive programs adapted for pregnancy and postnatal recovery.

07

Flexibility & body awareness

Develop a more flexible, stronger and toned you — with a deeper connection to how your body moves.

08

Age-related support

Pilates aids age-related decline and movement dysfunction, with programs adapted to individual needs and functional goals.

09

For all populations

Suitable for all fitness levels — whether you're new to this or a master of the craft.

Services

Ways to practise

Initial consultation

Private Pilates lessons

This is a personalized one-on-one session designed to address your individual goals and needs.

Duet Pilates lessons

This is a semi-private session where two clients work together under my guidance. Your sessions will be tailored to suit both participants' objectives/goals and any individual needs.

Benefits

The Power of Pilates

Pilates is a low-impact exercise method that strengthens the core, improves flexibility, and enhances body awareness. It focuses on controlled movements, proper breathing, and alignment to build strength, improve posture, and promote mental clarity.

Suitable for all fitness levels, Pilates fosters balance, coordination, and long-term wellness by integrating mind and body.

—

Strength & posture

Controlled movements and alignment build strength and improve posture.

—

Balance & coordination

Balance, coordination and long-term wellness, integrating mind and body.

—

Mental clarity

Proper breathing and mindful movement promote mental clarity.

Meet your instructor

Hello, I'm Sarah

With over eight years' experience, Sarah is a certified Pilates instructor holding a Diploma in the Pilates Method for PilatesITC. A proud member of the Pilates Alliance Australia, she has taught at a Brisbane studio and currently operates her own home-based studio on the Gold Coast.

With a background in dance and as a registered nurse with QLD health, Sarah is passionate about using Pilates to enhance health, support injury recovery, and empower individuals to manage chronic pain through tailored movement and mindful practices.

Studio Experience

Inside the studio

Explore all — develop a more flexible, stronger and toned you. Pilates is a physical fitness system developed in the early 20th century by Joseph Pilates, after whom it was named. Pilates called his method "Contrology". It is practiced worldwide, especially in Western countries such as Australia, Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom. Whether you're new to this or a master of the craft, Primed for Pilates will help you in whatever your goals are.
